distance_metrics.bucket_rule: tie-aware empirical terciles fixed before method evaluation
distance_metrics.gap: task-optimal value minus the value of deploying the true source-optimal leader policy on that task
distance_metrics.tv: half the L1 distance between true source- and task-optimal leader policies

evaluation.cell_statistic: arithmetic mean over every task in a bucket and all 50 seeds

purpose: algorithm-blind transfer-distance heatmaps from retained current-protocol coefficient histories

task_policy.candidate_distribution: independent target priorities z_b ~ Uniform[-1,1], evaluated for every candidate without performance-based selection
task_policy.name: fresh_behavioral
task_policy.normalization: positive-affine normalization to [0,1] per task; R_max=1
